result_text:
The "Undefined Team" remainder now only collects active contributors. Dormant unmatched contributors are left out.

**Change:** one condition in `getAllTeams()` in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/landscape/analysis/LandscapeAnalysisResults.java` (around line 747). A contributor goes into the remainder only if `!added[0] && contributor.getContributor().isActive() && ...`.

**Blank dates:** no extra code needed. `DateUtils.isDateWithinRange` already returns true for a blank date, so contributors with no latest-commit date stay in the remainder.

**Configured teams:** untouched. Their members are added before the remainder check, so they keep all members, active or not.

**Tests:** `mvn -q -o -pl codeanalyzer test -Dtest=ContributorTest` passed with no output. I did not add a test for the remainder filter itself, and I did not run the reports module.

I did not commit.
